title: Reset a forgotten password
text: Open the company sign-in page and choose Forgot password. Enter your work email and verify with the code sent to your registered phone. Create a new password with at least 12 characters and sign in again.

title: Account locked after failed sign-ins
text: An account locks for 30 minutes after five wrong password attempts. Wait for the lock to expire or ask the service desk to unlock it after identity verification. Avoid saved old passwords on phones, which often cause repeated lockouts.

title: Connect to the VPN from home
text: Install the approved VPN client from the software portal and sign in with your work account. Choose the nearest gateway and approve the multi factor prompt. Once the status shows connected you can reach internal websites and shared drives.

title: VPN disconnects repeatedly
text: Frequent VPN drops are usually caused by weak home internet or a sleeping laptop. Switch to a wired connection or move closer to the router, disable power saving for the network adapter, and reconnect to a different gateway. Raise a ticket with the time of each drop if it continues.

title: Cannot find or join the office Wi-Fi
text: Turn Wi-Fi off and on, then forget the office network and join it again using your work credentials. Confirm the laptop is not in airplane mode and the date and time are correct. If the network name is missing, move to another floor and report the location to the service desk.

title: Printer shows offline
text: Check the printer is powered on and connected to the network, then set it as the default printer on your computer. Clear stuck jobs from the print queue and restart the print spooler service. If it still shows offline, note the printer label and raise a ticket.

title: Outlook is not receiving new email
text: Check that Outlook is not in offline mode and that your mailbox is not full. Close and reopen Outlook, then send yourself a test message. If the problem remains, recreate the mail profile or raise a ticket with the exact error message.

title: Multi factor prompts after changing phone
text: Sign-in approvals are linked to your old device until you register the new one. Use a backup code or ask the service desk to reset your authentication method after identity verification. Then scan the new QR code in the authenticator app on your new phone.

title: Request new software
text: Search for the application in the software portal and install it directly if it is listed as approved. For anything not listed, submit a software request with the business reason and manager approval. Installation after approval usually completes within two working days.

title: Laptop running very slowly
text: Restart the laptop and close unused browser tabs and applications. Check Task Manager for programs using high memory or disk and make sure at least 15 percent of storage is free. Install pending system updates, and raise a ticket if the slowness stays after a restart.

title: Blue screen error on Windows
text: Write down the stop code shown on the blue screen and let the computer restart. Unplug recently added devices and install pending Windows updates. If blue screens repeat, share the stop code in a ticket so the support team can check drivers and hardware.

title: No access to a shared folder
text: Access to team folders is granted by group membership. Confirm you are connected to the office network or VPN, then ask the folder owner to approve your access request in the access portal. Sign out and in again after approval so the new permission applies.

title: Microphone or speaker not working in video calls
text: Open the call settings and select the correct microphone and speaker, then unmute and raise the volume. Check that the headset is the default device in system sound settings and that the app has microphone permission. Rejoin the meeting after changing devices.

title: Recover a deleted file
text: Look in the Recycle Bin first and restore the file to its original location. For files on the shared drive or cloud storage, use Previous versions or the cloud recycle bin, which keeps items for 30 days. Contact the service desk quickly if the file is not found.

title: Report a suspicious email
text: Do not click links, open attachments or reply to a suspicious message. Use the Report phishing button in your mail client or forward it to the security mailbox. If you already entered your password, change it immediately and tell the service desk.

title: Ticket priority and response times
text: Tickets are ranked by business impact. A high priority ticket receives a first response within one hour and a target resolution of four hours. Medium priority is answered within four hours and low priority within one working day.

title: When to escalate a ticket
text: Escalate to the next support level when the issue is not resolved within the target time, needs access the first level does not have, or affects many users. Add the troubleshooting steps already tried, error messages and user contact details to the ticket before escalating. Keep the user updated on the status.

title: Lost or stolen laptop
text: Report a lost or stolen laptop to the service desk and security team immediately. The device will be locked remotely and your account passwords will be reset. Also file a police report if the device was stolen and share the reference number in the ticket.

title: Website not loading properly
text: Refresh the page and try a private window to rule out saved data problems. Clear the browser cache and cookies for the site and disable extensions one at a time. If the site fails on every browser, report the web address and the error shown.

title: External monitor not detected
text: Check the cable and the monitor input source, then press the Windows key and P to choose an extend or duplicate mode. Update the display driver and try a different port or cable. Share the laptop model and monitor model in the ticket if it is still not detected.
